plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review the diff while you code: a panel of focused review lenses, a second-model review (Codex, Claude or open-code-review), and hooks that nudge a review every few commits and after a large edit. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: review-lenses
plugins.description: Opt-in review lenses for the panel, chosen by the files a diff touches: database migrations, multi-tenant isolation, sync cursors, performance, architecture rules. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Open and maintain pull requests: $pr, PR writing style, all-surfaces PR feedback, the Codex review sweep, GitHub issues, and PR-description drift nudges. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Tech design docs (RFCs) written fork by fork, their review, task breakdowns into shippable slices, and ADRs. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: queue
plugins.description: Ship work unattended between gates: one task, a whole label queue, or a bug hunt, each fix through the merge gate and the review panel to a pull request. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Copies local untracked files into each new git worktree and anchors subagents to their worktree, through Claude Code hooks that have no effect on Codex. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Hooks around an agent's commands and edits: a configurable commit gate, a lockfile sync gate, pinned npx, format on edit, and generated-file and doc-health advisories. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Extracts an abstracted profile of how you work with an agent, scrubbed for credentials, and shares it as a pull request. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: Set up a repo for the kit: $setup writes the settings file, the deny list, the always-on rules, githooks and the rule index; a short guide maps situations to skills. Tested on Claude Code 2.1.289+ and Codex CLI 0.159.0+.
